## Japan Family Trip Snapshot for 2 Adults + 2 Children

A quick read: all three options fit the **AUD 8,500** budget, but your priority is fewer layovers, so the strongest fit is the option with the smoothest flights even if it is not the cheapest.

## Recommendation Table: Sydney to Japan, 2025-10-05 to 2025-10-12

| Option | Flights | Hotel | Transfers | Total | Budget Fit | Layovers | Best Fit |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | AUD 4,200 | AUD 2,900 | AUD 300 | **AUD 7,400** | Yes | **1 each way** | Balanced choice |
| 2 | AUD 3,700 | AUD 3,400 | AUD 250 | **AUD 7,350** | Yes | **2 each way** | Best hotel, weakest flights |
| 3 | AUD 4,600 | AUD 2,600 | AUD 400 | **AUD 7,600** | Yes | **Nonstop out, 1 layover back** | **Best overall for your priority** |

## Best Option by Your Priorities

**Recommended: Option 3**
- **Why it wins:** it has the fewest layovers overall, including a **nonstop outbound** flight.
- **Trade-off:** hotel is only **3-star**, so comfort shifts from lodging to travel convenience.
- **Total cost:** **AUD 7,600**, leaving **AUD 900** under budget.

**Runner-up: Option 1**
- Good middle ground with **1 layover each way** and a **4-star hotel**.
- Lower total than Option 3, but not as travel-friendly.

**Least aligned with your preference: Option 2**
- Cheapest hotel-and-flight mix overall, but **2 layovers each way** is the most tiring for a family trip.
- Best only if hotel comfort matters more than flight simplicity.

## Best Chart Type for This Comparison

Use a **stacked bar chart** for the clearest visual comparison.

- **X-axis:** Option 1, Option 2, Option 3
- **Y-axis:** AUD total cost
- **Stack segments:** Flight, Hotel, Transfers
- **Overlay label or side annotation:** Layovers each way

Why this works:
- It shows the **full trip cost breakdown** at a glance.
- It makes the **layover trade-off** easy to compare alongside price.
- It is better than a pie chart because you need to compare **three complete trip packages**, not just one total.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Compare visually] https://www.canva.com/graphs/bar-charts/
Action: [Button: Plan family trip] https://www.google.com/travel/

- Australia travel planning overview: https://www.australia.com/en
- Japan travel information: https://www.japan.travel/en/
